ranking_evidence.quote: 5,C0041,Transience in a direction implies ballisticity for uniformly elliptic i.i.d. RWR,attempted_un,"transience implies ballisticity, UE i.i.d., d>=2"

historical_source.authors: Alexander Drewitz and Alejandro F. Ramirez
historical_source.locator: Open question 2.20, printed p. 22, PDF p. 23; definitions 2.1-2.3 and 2.13-2.14
historical_source.exact_statement: For d >= 2, a nearest-neighbor RWRE on Z^d with an i.i.d. law of site transition rows and deterministic kappa > 0 lower bound on every nearest-neighbor transition, does annealed-almost-sure X_n dot l -> +infinity for a unit vector l imply annealed-almost-sure liminf (X_n dot l)/n > 0?
